turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Both dresses offer great value, so it comes down to how you plan to wear them!
The Oasis Smocked Waist Dress ($82.80) is fantastic if you want maximum versatility on a tighter budget. Its flattering A-line cut, smocked waist, and soft wrinkle-resistant fabric let it function as a casual dress, a chic cover-up, or a day-to-night option.
The Flora 1/4 Zip Sport Dress ($110.40) is worth the extra $27.60 if you need specific active features. It includes functional side pockets, moisture-wicking sport fabric, and underarm mesh ventilation for cooling comfort during golf, tennis, or active days outdoors.
If you don't need the active performance features or pockets, the Oasis Smocked Waist Dress is more than fine and gives you incredible style for less!
